meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先核对最新源码与运行证据，判断 bug 归属，然后起草一份规范 issue（含复现步骤、根因、修复建议），提交到对应 GitHub 仓库并附 lazycodex-generated 标签；仅当目标是上游 Codex 且你要求时才创建 PR。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或分类一个 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等相关的 bug，尤其是需要查根因、复现步骤或决定归属哪个仓库时。

say.text: 帮我为 LazyCodex 的安装失败报个 bug，写清复现步骤和根因。
say.note: 会去核实源码并生成对应 issue。

say.text: 这个崩溃在纯上游 Codex 也能复现，请创建一个 PR。
say.note: 符合条件才在 openai/codex 建 PR。

say.text: 先搜索两个仓库里已有的 issue，有重复就补充证据。
say.note: 有重复就评论，不重复建。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude checks source and runtime evidence, routes the bug to the right repo, and drafts a structured issue (steps, cause, fix) with the lazycodex-generated label; PRs only for openai/codex when asked.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI, especially when root cause, repro steps, or repo routing is needed.

say_en.text: File a LazyCodex installer bug with repro steps and root cause.
say_en.note: Claude investigates and files an issue in the right repo.

say_en.text: This crash reproduces on clean upstream Codex, draft a PR please.
say_en.note: PRs are only created for openai/codex.

say_en.text: Search both repos for existing issues first, then add evidence there.
say_en.note: Comment on duplicates instead of filing new ones.
